hero.title: Every Tibia resource your fansite needs, from one desktop app
hero.lead: Tibia Foundry reads the official files of your installed Tibia client and turns them into sprites, animated outfit and creature GIFs, item images, maps, sounds and data – then keeps everything in a searchable library and publishes complete galleries for TibiaWiki or any community website.

audience.title: Built for the people who keep the Tibia community informed
audience.lead: Whether you run a wiki, a fansite, a guild page or a YouTube channel, the same chores come back with every client update. Tibia Foundry does them for you.

fansites.title: Fansite administrators
fansites.text: Consistent creature, outfit and item galleries, update pages and downloadable resource packs – generated in the format your site uses.

wiki.title: Wiki editors
wiki.text: Ready-to-paste {{Infobox Object}} markup, correctly named images, animated GIFs, item IDs, creature and house data, and a file-link snippet for every image you upload.

artists.title: Artists and designers
artists.text: Transparent sprites, sprite sheets, interface artwork and pixel-exact enlargements (nearest-neighbor: no blur, no new colors).

maps.title: Map creators
maps.text: Map images, areas and NPC positions from the client's map data, high-resolution maps for guides and a picture of every house.

creators.title: Content creators
creators.text: Sounds and music of the client, comparison sheets for videos and articles, and the metadata and credits of everything you publish.

players.title: Curious players
players.text: Browse every object, outfit, effect, creature and quest of the official client, and keep each client version for history.

features.kicker: One application instead of a dozen tools
features.title: Everything from the client to the published page
features.lead: {plural:tools:23}, grouped by task, sharing one client, one library and one set of export rules.

clients.title: Client management
clients.text: Finds your installed live and test-server clients, loads client folders from anywhere and archives every version space-efficiently – verified file by file and rebuildable later.

extraction.title: Asset extraction
extraction.text: Transparent sprites or whole sprite sheets, every object, outfit, effect and missile, creature and quest data, and the client's sounds and music.
extraction.tools: Extract Sprites · Appearances · Static Data · Sounds

graphics.title: Graphics creation
graphics.text: Animated GIFs with fansite presets, colored outfits with addons and mounts, creature animations and 1×–8× pixel-exact enlargement.

editing.title: Resource editing
editing.text: Inspect and edit a copy of the official assets, extract and rebuild Qt resource files, write classic Tibia.dat/.spr copies, edit file metadata.
editing.tools: Assets Editor · RCC Editor · Client Converter · File Metadata

maps.title: Maps and houses
maps.text: Map images, areas and NPC positions, high-resolution maps for guides, and house images for every house article.

library.title: Asset management
library.text: A searchable library of every image, animation and sound – collections, tags, versions, duplicate detection – with every export added automatically.

workflows.title: Content workflows
workflows.text: Reusable projects that render creature, outfit and item galleries, update resources and wiki images – configured once, run again with every update.

batch.title: Batch generation
batch.text: Hundreds of images in one run, in a background queue with progress, cancellation and retry; batch renaming, resizing and conversion scripts.

publishing.title: Publishing for any site
publishing.text: Profiles for TibiaWiki, your fansite, galleries, articles or an archive: sizes, formats, names, folders, manifests, credits and snippets.

library.title: Find any resource in seconds, never lose one again
library.lead: Your sprites, GIFs, renders, maps, sounds and artwork in one searchable place. Files stay where they are; the library only reads them.
library.point1: Automatic: every file any tool exports is added in the background, with the tool and client version it came from.
library.point2: Search and filter: by name, game ID, category, client version, tag, format, size, date and more.
library.point3: Organize: your own categories, tags, custom fields, related assets and shareable collections.
library.point4: Duplicates: identical files, the same graphic at another size and look-alike images are reported – nothing is ever deleted for you.
library.point5: Safe: fast rescans, earlier versions of changed files, an integrity check, backup and restore – all stored locally and fully offline.

library.altLight: Close-up of the Asset Library in the light theme

studio.title: A whole gallery in one click – and again after every update
studio.lead: Choose what to make, adjust the steps, pick your site's profile and run it. Tibia Foundry renders, sizes, names, sorts, describes and packages everything in the background.
studio.point1: Project templates: creature gallery, outfit gallery, item image collection, map references, update resources, wiki image preparation, custom export.
studio.point2: Workflow builder: no programming needed – render, trim, resize, consistent canvas, format, names, folders, sheets, manifests, gallery, ZIP.
studio.point3: What changed?: renders every object and outfit that is new or changed since an older client – ready for update articles.
studio.point4: All or nothing: a cancelled or failed run leaves no half-finished export; originals are never modified.

safety.title: Your client and your files stay yours

readonly.title: Read-only on Tibia
readonly.text: The client folders are only read. Editors save copies elsewhere, and no tool writes into a client or archive folder.

atomic.title: Nothing half-done
atomic.text: Exports are written to a temporary place and moved into position only when complete; replaced files can be backed up and restored.

private.title: Local and private
private.text: No account, no cloud. TibiaWiki is contacted only by features that need it. Diagnostics reports leave out personal paths, so they are safe to share.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.a1: Yes. It is a free, independent community project with no account, no advertising and no paid features.
faq.q2: Does it change my Tibia client or my characters?
faq.a2: No. Tibia Foundry only reads the client's files. It never writes into a client folder, never touches your character, hotkeys or account, and does not interact with the game while it runs.
faq.q3: Where do the images come from, and may I publish them?
faq.a3: From the official client installed on your computer. Tibia's graphics and data are © CipSoft GmbH; Tibia Foundry writes that notice and your name as creator into every exported image. Follow CipSoft's rules for fansites and your website's own image policy.
faq.q4: Is the Asset Library uploaded anywhere?
faq.a4: No. The library is a SQLite database on your computer; your files stay where they are and are only read. Removing an asset from the library never deletes a file. Back it up or restore it from the library's Folders and storage tab.
faq.q5: Will it delete my duplicate images?
faq.a5: No. Find duplicates lists identical files, the same graphic at another size and look-alike images so you can decide what to keep. Nothing is deleted, moved or merged by the program.
faq.q6: Can I use it for my own fansite rather than TibiaWiki?
faq.a6: Yes – that is what publishing profiles are for. Create a profile with your sizes, formats, file names, folders, credit line and HTML or BBCode snippet; the TibiaWiki profile is just one example.
faq.q7: What happens after a Tibia update?
faq.a7: When it starts, Tibia Foundry checks the installed client in the background and offers to archive the new version. The Compatibility page reports how well the new files are understood, and an update-resources project renders everything new or changed since the previous version.
faq.a8: The installer for a normal installation with a Start-menu entry and uninstall; the portable edition to run it from any folder or USB stick without installing. Both are the same program.
faq.q9: Is Tibia Foundry affiliated with CipSoft or Fandom?
faq.a9: No. It is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CipSoft GmbH or Fandom. It is not part of CipSoft's Fansite Programme.

infobox.title: An item article's infobox, filled from the client
infobox.lead: Select an object in Appearances and open Wiki infobox: Tibia Foundry writes TibiaWiki's {{Infobox Object}} from the official client data, following the template's own parameters and the wiki's conventions. Review it, add what only you know, and paste it into the article.
infobox.point1: From the client: ID, names, look text (flavortext), slot, level and vocations, hands and weapon type, imbuement slots, upgrade class, object flags, light and map colour, stackable and marketable.
infobox.point2: NPC trade: the best NPC buy and sell prices and every trader, with their own price where it differs.
infobox.point3: Nothing invented: every value shows where it came from; implemented, weight, attack, armor and the other values the client does not hold are listed for you to fill in.
infobox.point4: Edit, copy, save: change any value, add more parameters, copy the markup, save it as .txt, or save one file for every selected object.
infobox.caption: Real output for Magic Plate Armor from the installed client – the empty lines are what the client cannot know.
